title: Diplomacy with China still OK despite ambassador's word war with PH officials—Palace
summary: The Philippines' diplomatic relations with China remain sound despite Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines' Jing Quan's recent word war with local officials, Malacañang said on Monday.
